title: Last BG value not shown on Main Screen and Widget
symptom: The current BG Level and Arrow is missing from both the main display and the widget on a Samsung S21 Ultra.
cause: The issue was resolved by turning the sensor on in xDrip, even though there wasn't one physically connected.
fix: Turn the sensor on in xDrip (even though there isn't one physically connected).
evidence_quote: Oh wow...it's started working! Here's what I did: I just went and turned the sensor on. Even though there isn't one!
